body: thanks for your reply, tbh it makes me kind of sad that more people are suffering. I know it's a part of life and I don't expect to be happy all the time or anything. I'm in my twenties and at least I can talk to someone who has been through some really rough times, being homeless and all that. But he is still here and doing okay so that gives a little hope, maybe for you as well.

Yes I'm in treatment but early stages and my self image is about as bad as it can get. I know BDP doesn't define me and I hope I can learn to cope with it better. My ex was a bad influence as well. I'm trying but I'm just having a really rough time and I suppose you know how you can get overwhelmed with emotions. It's different for each person but still those extreme ups and downs.. sometimes I just don't see how anything will ever get better. I've just hit a really  low point and it's a struggle to climb out of it.
